source.primary_witnesses: Aramaic DSS Astronomical-Book fragments (4Q208-4Q211) where preserved; Ge'ez as fallback. NO continuous Greek witness for chs 72-82.
source.transliteration_convention: Aramaic Imperial-Aramaic per Milik 1976 + Tigchelaar-García Martínez DJD XXXVI 2000; Ge'ez SBL convention.
source.verificationStatus: best-effort reconstruction; verification pending against Milik 1976, Tigchelaar-García Martínez 2000, Drawnel 2011, Neugebauer 1985.
source.fetchedFrom: Milik 1976 + Tigchelaar-García Martínez 2000 DJD XXXVI + Drawnel 2011 + Black 1985 + Charles 1912 + Knibb 1978 + Nickelsburg-VanderKam 2012.
source.citation: Milik 1976; Tigchelaar-García Martínez 2000; Drawnel 2011; Black 1985 (with Neugebauer 1985); Charles 1912 PD; Knibb 1978; Nickelsburg-VanderKam 2012.
source.paleography_note: CHAPTER 78 — THE NAMES OF SUN AND MOON + the moon's 14-day waxing + 14-day waning + the lunar synodic month. **4Q209 frags 7+ preserves significant Aramaic parallel for the lunar tabulations** that the Ge'ez compresses. CROSS-CORPUS to Gen 1:14-19 (the two great lights); cf. Sefer Yetzirah on the moon's monthly cycle.

verses.text_geez: ወስማቲሆሙ፡ ለፀሐይ፡ እሉ፡ ቀዳማይ፡ ኦርያረስ፡ ካልዕ፡ ቶሞስ፡
verses.translit: wa-səmātihomu la-ḍaḥay ʾəllu qadāmāyə ʾOryāras kāləʿ Tomos
verses.witness_secondary: Aramaic 4Q209 not preserved for this verse; conjectured Aramaic original names
verses.notes: **THE TWO NAMES OF THE SUN: ʾOryāras and Tomos.** Charles 1912 conjectured these as transliterations of Hebrew/Aramaic ʾOR-YĀRĒḤA ('light of the moon' — likely a corruption from a sun-paired-with-moon context) and Aramaic TAMMŪZ (the Mesopotamian solar/seasonal deity; cf. Ezek 8:14 women weeping for Tammuz). The names likely reflect Hellenistic-period syncretism of solar deities. Neugebauer 1985 read these as Greek ouranos + chōmos. Editor: scholarly crux.

verses.text_geez: ወወርኅሰ፡ አርባዕቱ፡ ስማቲሁ፡ ቀዳማይ፡ አሰናያ፡ ወካልዕ፡ አበል፡ ወሣልስ፡ በናሴ፡ ወራብዕ፡ ኤራዔ፡
verses.translit: wa-warḫəsa ʾarbāʿtu səmātihu qadāmāyə ʾAsanāyā wa-kāləʿ ʾAbal wa-śāləs Banāsē wa-rābəʿ ʾĒraʾē
verses.notes: **THE FOUR NAMES OF THE MOON: ʾAsanāyā, ʾAbal, Banāsē, ʾĒraʾē.** Charles 1912 conjectured these as the lunar phases or as transliterations of Aramaic SAHRĀʾ ('moon')/LĒBĀNĀʾ ('white moon'). The 4-name system likely corresponds to the moon's 4 phases (new, first-quarter, full, last-quarter). Editor: scholarly crux.

verses.text_geez: እሉ፡ ክልኤቱ፡ ብርሃናት፡ ዐበይት፡ ዘክብ፡ ዘክብ፡ ብርሃኖሙ፡ ዐቢይ፡ ለበበ፡ ግድፋቶሙ፡ ይከውን፡
verses.translit: ʾəllu kəlʾētu bərhānāt ʿabayt zakəb zakəb bərhānomu ʿabəy laba-gədəfātomu yəkawwən
verses.notes: **The two great lights — their orb is equal in size.** This is a calendrical-cosmographic claim: same apparent disk-size for sun and moon (which is the empirical reality of solar eclipses). Note the harmonic-symmetry observation.

verses.text_geez: ወበኪራ፡ ለፀሐይ፡ ስብዐ፡ ምስለ፡ ብርሃኑ፡ ለወርኅ፡ ይትዌቅሕ፡ እስከ፡ የሐጽጽ፡ ምስለ፡ ብርሃና፡ ለፀሐይ፡ ስብዐ፡
verses.translit: wa-ba-kīrā la-ḍaḥay səbʿa məsla bərhānu la-warḫ yətwaḳḳəḥ ʾəska yaḥaḍḍəḍ məsla bərhānā la-ḍaḥay səbʿa
verses.notes: **The sun's light is sevenfold the moon's — restated for the third time** (cf. 72:37; 73:3). The 7:1 luminosity is THE schematic-foundation for moonlight-fractional computations.

verses.text_geez: በበ፡ ለፀሐይ፡ ስብዐ፡ ምስለ፡ ብርሃኑ፡ ለፀሐይ፡ ይትዐጻዕ፡ ብርሃና፡ ለወርኅ፡ ሕገገ፡ ለዘይነውኅ፡ ብርሃና፡
verses.translit: baba la-ḍaḥay səbʿa məsla bərhānu la-ḍaḥay yətʿaḍāʿ bərhānā la-warḫ ḥəgaga la-zayənawwəḫ bərhānā
verses.witness_secondary: Aramaic 4Q209 frags 7-8 preserves trace fractional-light tabulation (Drawnel 2011 pp. 240-250)
verses.notes: Moon's light gradually grows by 7-fold subdivision until full.

verses.text_geez: ወበቀዳሚት፡ ዕለታ፡ ይከውን፡ ምዕር፡ ስብዐ፡ ምክፋላት፡ ኮኖ፡ አሐደ፡ ለብርሃኑ፡ ለፀሐይ፡ ወብርሃና፡ የሐጽጽ፡ እምነ፡ ዘኮነ፡ በዘ፡ ቀዳሚት፡ ዕለታ፡ ስብዐ፡ ምክፋላት፡ ስብዐ፡
verses.translit: wa-ba-qadāmit ʿəlatā yəkawwən məʿr səbʿa məkfālāt kono ʾaḥada la-bərhānu la-ḍaḥay wa-bərhānā yaḥaḍḍəḍ ʾəmənna zakona baza qadāmit ʿəlatā səbʿa məkfālāt səbʿa
verses.witness_secondary: Aramaic 4Q208 frag 1 / 4Q209 frag 7 col. i lines 1-10 preserves Aramaic of the daily 49-unit fractional tabulation (Drawnel 2011 pp. 217-240 — THIS IS THE MOST DRAMATIC ARAMAIC-VS-GE'EZ EXPANSION)
verses.text_aramaic: וביום קדמי דירחא יהוה נהורהא חד מן שבעא חולקי שבעא די לסיהרא
verses.notes: **THE 7×7 = 49-UNIT MOONLIGHT GRID.** Day 1 of lunar month: light = 1/49 of full. This is THE Aramaic-Ge'ez expansion crux: **4Q208 preserves the full day-by-day 1→14 waxing table + 14→1 waning table** in fractional-7ths arithmetic, while the Ge'ez compresses to summary-statements. The Aramaic stratum here is ~5x the length of the Ge'ez. Editor: significant text not in Ge'ez may need appendix-treatment.

verses.text_geez: ወትገብእ፡ ብርሃና፡ ለሁስስ፡ በምዕር፡ በዕለታ፡ ስብዐ፡ ምክፋላት፡ ስብዐ፡ ለቀዳማይ፡ ብርሃና፡ ይከውን፡ ካልዕተ፡ ምሉአ፡
verses.translit: wa-təgabbəʾ bərhānā la-husas ba-məʿr ba-ʿəlatā səbʿa məkfālāt səbʿa la-qadāmāyə bərhānā yəkawwən kāləʿta məluʾa
verses.notes: Day-by-day increment of 1/49 per day; full moon at day 14.

verses.text_geez: ወትከውን፡ ጊዜ፡ መካን፡ ስቱረ፡ ምዕር፡ ምክፋላት፡ ስብዐ፡ ምስለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ለቀዳማይ፡ ብርሃና፡ ስብዐ፡
verses.translit: wa-təkawwən gizē makān sətura məʿr məkfālāt səbʿa məsla kwəlu la-qadāmāyə bərhānā səbʿa
verses.notes: **At full-moon: light = 14/14 = full = 7 sevenths.** The 14-day waxing completes.

verses.text_geez: ወትገብእ፡ ብርሃና፡ በስብዐቱ፡ ምክፋላት፡ ይትገብእ፡ እምነ፡ ምልዕተ፡ ብርሃና፡ ለመጥፋዕት፡ በበ፡ ስብዐቱ፡ መዋዕል፡
verses.translit: wa-təgabbəʾ bərhānā ba-səbʿatu məkfālāt yətgabbəʾ ʾəmənna məlʿta bərhānā la-maṭfāʿt baba səbʿatu mawāʿəl
verses.notes: **14-day WANING begins.** Light decreases by 7-day weekly markers down to extinction.

verses.text_geez: ወበዕለታት፡ እኩያን፡ የሐጽጽ፡ ብርሃና፡ በበ፡ ዕለታ፡ እምነ፡ ዐሥር፡ ወአርባዕቱ፡ ዕለታት፡
verses.translit: wa-ba-ʿəlatāt ʾəkuyān yaḥaḍḍəḍ bərhānā baba ʿəlatā ʾəmənna ʿaśr wa-ʾarbāʿtu ʿəlatāt
verses.notes: Light wanes day by day across 14 days.

verses.text_geez: ወበዕለታት፡ ሠናያት፡ ዕለታት፡ ምሉእ፡ ብርሃና፡ ለወርኅ፡
verses.translit: wa-ba-ʿəlatāt śannāyāt ʿəlatāt məluʾ bərhānā la-warḫ
verses.notes: Days of waxing = 'good days' (śannāyāt); days of waning = 'bad days' (ʾəkuyān, v. 10). Editor: the moral-valencing of lunar phase ('good' = waxing, 'bad' = waning) is a notable conceptual move — a moralization of lunar physics.

verses.text_geez: ወሶበ፡ ይትጽህፍ፡ ሎቱ፡ መንበሩ፡ ለፀሐይ፡ መንገለ፡ ምዕራብ፡ ይትገብእ፡ ለመንበረ፡ ብርሃኑ፡ ለፀሐይ፡ ቅድመ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ በመዋዕለ፡ ስልሳ፡ ዕለታት፡
verses.translit: wa-soba yətṣəḥf lotu manbaru la-ḍaḥay mangala məʿrāb yətgabbəʾ la-manbara bərhānu la-ḍaḥay qədma məśrāq ba-mawāʿəla səlsā ʿəlatāt
verses.notes: Sun-position return-cycle over 60 days; the moon's positions relative to the sun reset accordingly. Synodic-month mechanics.

verses.text_geez: ወይትገብእ፡ ብርሃና፡ ለወርኅ፡ ምዕር፡ ምልዕተ፡ በምሥራቅ፡ በዘ፡ ዕለታ፡ ቀዳማይ፡ ለስብአ፡ ስብአ፡ ምዕር፡
verses.translit: wa-yətgabbəʾ bərhānā la-warḫ məʿr məlʿta ba-məśrāq baza ʿəlatā qadāmāyə la-səbʾa səbʾa məʿr
verses.notes: Moon's light completes its rising 7-fold cycle starting from east.

verses.text_geez: ወበበ፡ መዋዕል፡ ዘሥሉስ፡ ይከውን፡ ናዕታ፡ ስልሳ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ለፀሐይ፡ ዘይትፌጸም፡ ለዐሥር፡ ምንታት፡ ለወርኅ፡ ወክልኤቱ፡ መዋዕል፡ ይትኄፀጽ፡
verses.translit: wa-baba mawāʿəl zaśəlus yəkawwən nāʿtā səlsā mawāʿəla la-ḍaḥay zayətfēṣam la-ʿaśr məntat la-warḫ wa-kəlʾētu mawāʿəl yətḫēḍaṣ
verses.notes: Triennial sun-moon reckonings reset; the 30-day intercalation explained again (matches 1 En 74:15).

verses.text_geez: ወወርኅ፡ ያመጽእ፡ ሕገገ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ለመዓልታት፡ ሠላሳ፡ ወባሕቱ፡ ይትኄፀጽ፡ ይከውን፡ መዓልታት፡ ኃያን፡ ወሐኪ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ብርሃን፡ ምሉእ፡
verses.translit: wa-warḫ yāmaṣṣəʾ ḥəgaga mawāʿəla la-maʿāltāt śallāsā wa-bāḥtu yətḫēḍaṣ yəkawwən maʿāltāt ḫāyān wa-ḥakk wa-ʾalbo bərhān məluʾ
verses.notes: **THE 29/30-DAY LUNAR MONTH ALTERNATION.** Some months are 30, some are 29 (the 'short' months — 'days that are hollow' / ḫāyān). The 29.5-day synodic month is schematized as alternating 29/30.

verses.text_geez: ወሐምሳ፡ ስድስቱ፡ መንበሮሙ፡ መዋዕል፡ ለስብአ፡ መዋዕል፡ መትግባእቱ፡ ለወርኅ፡ ምልዕተ፡ ብርሃና፡ ዘሐሳቡ፡ ኮነ፡ ለ፪፻፷፪ ዕለታት፡
verses.translit: wa-ḥamsā sədəstu manbaromu mawāʿəl la-səbʾa mawāʿəl matgəbāʾətu la-warḫ məlʿta bərhānā zaḥasāb kona la-262 ʿəlatāt
verses.notes: Lunar cycle reckonings — corrupted Ge'ez. Charles 1912 attempts emendation.

verses.text_geez: ወቅያስ፡ ለሙዋዕል፡ ለስብአ፡ መንበራት፡ ይትፌጸም፡ ናኦተ፡ በመዋዕል፡ ቀዳማይ፡ መጥፋዕተ፡ ብርሃኑ፡ ይትገብእ፡ ለስብአ፡ መዋዕል፡ ምሉአ፡ ብርሃና፡
verses.translit: wa-qəyās la-mawāʿəl la-səbʾa manbarāt yətfēṣam nāʾota ba-mawāʿəl qadāmāyə maṭfāʿta bərhānu yətgabbəʾ la-səbʾa mawāʿəl məluʾa bərhānā
verses.notes: Final summary of lunar cycle's 7-day phase boundaries.
